C:P1.21.text: Freshpet earns the Clean Label Project Purity Award

C:P1.22.text: Freshpet has received Clean Label Project’s Purity Award across our portfolio, which means our recipes meet their highest purity standard based on independent testing for contaminants. Clean Label Project is a non-profit that tests products beyond traditional food safety standards looking for “hidden” contaminants such as heavy metals (e.g., lead, mercury, arsenic, cadmium) as well as pesticides and plasticizers.
